## <a id="questions"></a>Questions reported for Databricks

### [Inference, serving and cost](../themes/inference-economics.md)

- **[After a deployment, p99 latency doubles although model weights are unchanged. How do you isolate the cause?](../themes/inference-economics.md#inf-tail-regression)**
  - Applied scenario · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †, Databricks †, [OpenAI](openai.md) †, [Perplexity](perplexity.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/engineering.md#inf-tail-regression)
  - Tests: Whether diagnosis separates queueing, scheduling, dependencies and traffic changes.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Compare traffic mix, queue time and per-stage latency before and after release.
    - Inspect cache hit rates, batching, dependency tails and resource saturation.
    - Reproduce one hypothesis at a time and use a rollback or canary to verify causality.
  - Read: [The Tail at Scale](https://research.google/pubs/the-tail-at-scale/) (Dean and Barroso, Google Research)

### [RAG and retrieval](../themes/rag-retrieval.md)

- **[Design retrieval that enforces the source system's access rights, including permission changes and shared caches.](../themes/rag-retrieval.md#rag-permissions)**
  - System design · Asked at: Databricks †, [Microsoft](microsoft.md) †, [Palantir](palantir.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/engineering.md#rag-permissions)
  - Tests: Whether access checks cover the full path to generated output.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Propagate identity and enforce authorisation before content reaches the model.
    - Keep permission updates, deletions and cache keys consistent with the policy.
    - Test denied access and revocation paths; citations and logs need the same boundary.
  - Read: [Document-level access control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/search-document-level-access-overview) (Microsoft Learn)

### [Fine-tuning and post-training](../themes/post-training.md)

- **[Choose between prompt changes, retrieval and finetuning for a failing AI feature; include data freshness, latency and total cost.](../themes/post-training.md#pt-method-choice)**
  - Applied scenario · Asked at: Databricks †, [Microsoft](microsoft.md) †, [OpenAI](openai.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/engineering.md#pt-method-choice)
  - Tests: Whether the intervention matches the observed failure mode.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Classify missing knowledge, poor instructions and unwanted behaviour separately.
    - Establish a prompt baseline; test retrieval for fresh attributable knowledge.
    - Use finetuning when representative examples justify it, then compare lifecycle cost and held-out quality.
  - Read: [Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11401) (Lewis et al., arXiv) · [LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09685) (Hu et al., arXiv)

### [AI system design](../themes/ai-system-design.md)

- **[Design a knowledge assistant over ten million enterprise documents with per-user permissions and a continuously changing corpus.](../themes/ai-system-design.md#sd-enterprise-rag)**
  - System design · Asked at: [Amazon](amazon.md) †, Databricks †, [Microsoft](microsoft.md) †, [OpenAI](openai.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/engineering.md#sd-enterprise-rag)
  - Tests: Whether ingestion, retrieval, access control and serving form an operable system.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Clarify query volume, freshness and permission semantics before sizing.
    - Separate ingestion and index versions from query-time authorisation and retrieval.
    - Evaluate grounded answers and test revocation, stale data and partial outages.
  - Read: [Document-level access control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/search-document-level-access-overview) (Microsoft Learn) · [Contextual Retrieval in AI Systems](https://www.anthropic.com/news/contextual-retrieval) (Anthropic)
- **[Design natural-language querying over a warehouse with thousands of tables, from schema selection to safe query execution.](../themes/ai-system-design.md#sd-text-to-sql)**
  - System design · Asked at: Databricks †, [Palantir](palantir.md) †
  - Tests: Whether semantic correctness and query permissions constrain generation.

### [AI product strategy and metrics](../themes/ai-product-strategy.md)

- **[How do you prioritise a product roadmap when several valuable opportunities compete?](../themes/ai-product-strategy.md#prod-roadmap)**
  - Product case · Senior · Asked at: Databricks †
  - Tests: Whether prioritisation exposes assumptions and opportunity cost.

### [Applied and customer scenarios](../themes/applied-scenarios.md)

- **[A customer insists on fine-tuning their own model on support tickets, while you suspect retrieval would be enough. How do you proceed?](../themes/applied-scenarios.md#app-finetuning-request)**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: Databricks † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#app-finetuning-request)
  - Tests: Whether you investigate the need without turning architecture preferences into a sales argument.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Ask what ownership is meant to achieve: behaviour, knowledge, cost or control.
    - Build a representative task set and compare plausible approaches.
    - Explain data governance, maintenance and migration costs before recommending.
  - Read: [Rules of Machine Learning](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/guides/rules-of-ml) (Google for Developers) · [Building Effective AI Agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents) (Anthropic)
- **[A deployed agent's base model will be retired in 60 days. How would you migrate it without losing quality?](../themes/applied-scenarios.md#app-model-retirement)**
  - Applied scenario · Senior · Asked at: Databricks † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#app-model-retirement)
  - Tests: Whether provider lifecycle risk is handled through reproducible evaluation and controlled change.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Inventory affected workflows, tool contracts and model-specific behaviour.
    - Compare candidates against representative recorded tasks and failure cases.
    - Plan staged migration, rollback within the available window and customer communication.
  - Read: [Demystifying evals for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents) (Anthropic) · [Site Reliability Engineering](https://sre.google/sre-book/table-of-contents/) (Google)
